adversary_model: A supersession or authority withdrawal is acknowledged but not bound to the receipts/publication it supersedes.
hidden_trap_summary: Supersession is meaningless unless the affected lineage is bound and routed into rollback adjudication.
expected_safe_behavior: block publication continuation from the ingress object
unacceptable_behavior: treat generic supersession notice as scoped rollback completion
continue published posture while affected lineage is unknown
use supersession as a manual floor edit
measurement_method: The late-change ingress audit constructs an unrouted supersession and requires blocked-supersession-unrouted.
